name: community-lobby
summary: Captain vote: teammates' votes count from the first round (FangsHost decides per match whether there is a vote)

assets.why: Captain vote: the game counted teammates' Captain votes only from round 4 on (before that the Captain was random). Now from round 1: with the custom-lobby option Captain vote on, teammates vote every round; with it off, and in Casual and Ranked, the game server votes at random for everyone, so the Captain stays random.
